icons.name: Home
icons.meaning: Returns you to the app’s or website’s starting screen.
icons.example: Use Home when you want to return to the main page without closing the app.
icons.caution: Home does not usually sign you out or close the app.
icons.audio_text: The Home icon returns you to the app’s or website’s starting screen.

icons.name: Back
icons.meaning: Returns to the screen or page you just left.
icons.example: Use Back if you opened the wrong page and want to return to the previous one.
icons.caution: In a form, going back may remove information that has not been saved.
icons.audio_text: The Back icon returns to the screen or page you just left.

icons.name: Menu
icons.meaning: Opens a list of sections, pages, or choices.
icons.example: Select Menu to find items such as Profile, Help, Settings, or Sign Out.
icons.caution: The menu may close when you select outside it; nothing has been deleted.
icons.audio_text: The Menu icon opens a list of sections, pages, or choices.

icons.name: Search
icons.meaning: Helps you find a person, file, setting, message, or topic.
icons.example: Select Search, type a word, and review the matching results.
icons.caution: Search results may include advertisements or unfamiliar websites.
icons.audio_text: The Search icon helps you find a person, file, setting, message, or topic.

icons.name: More
icons.meaning: Opens additional choices that are not currently shown.
icons.example: Select the three dots to find actions such as Print, Share, Move, or Delete.
icons.caution: Review the choices before selecting; important actions may be inside this menu.
icons.audio_text: The More icon opens additional choices that are not currently shown.

icons.name: Add
icons.meaning: Creates or adds something new.
icons.example: Use Add for a new contact, message, calendar event, file, or browser tab.
icons.caution: Add does not always save the new item; look for Save or Done afterward.
icons.audio_text: The Add icon creates or adds something new.

icons.name: Edit
icons.meaning: Lets you change information that already exists.
icons.example: Use Edit to revise a contact, note, photograph, or document.
icons.caution: Look for Save, Apply, or Done so your changes are not lost.
icons.audio_text: The Edit icon lets you change information that already exists.

icons.name: Delete
icons.meaning: Removes the selected item.
icons.example: Use Delete to remove a message, photograph, contact, or file.
icons.caution: Pause before selecting Delete. Some items can be restored, while others cannot.
icons.audio_text: The Delete icon removes the selected item. Pause first because some items cannot be restored.

icons.name: Share
icons.meaning: Sends a copy or link to another person or app.
icons.example: Use Share to send a photo, webpage, document, or contact information.
icons.caution: Confirm the recipient and the information before sending it.
icons.audio_text: The Share icon sends a copy or link to another person or app. Confirm the recipient before sending.

icons.name: Download
icons.meaning: Saves a file or item onto your device.
icons.example: Use Download to save a statement, photograph, document, or application file.
icons.caution: Download files only from people and websites you trust.
icons.audio_text: The Download icon saves a file or item onto your device. Download only from sources you trust.

icons.name: Upload
icons.meaning: Sends a file from your device into an app, website, or cloud service.
icons.example: Use Upload to add a résumé, photograph, receipt, or supporting document to a website.
icons.caution: Check that the selected file does not contain information you did not intend to share.
icons.audio_text: The Upload icon sends a file from your device into an app, website, or cloud service.

icons.name: Attach
icons.meaning: Adds a file, photograph, or document to a message or form.
icons.example: Use the paperclip when an email or form asks you to include a document.
icons.caution: Open the attachment name before sending to confirm you selected the correct file.
icons.audio_text: The Attach icon adds a file, photograph, or document to a message or form.

icons.name: Settings
icons.meaning: Opens controls for how an app or device works.
icons.example: Use Settings to change text size, privacy, sound, display, notifications, or account options.
icons.caution: Change one setting at a time so it is easier to reverse if needed.
icons.audio_text: The Settings icon opens controls for how an app or device works. Change one setting at a time.

icons.name: Notifications
icons.meaning: Shows alerts, reminders, and recent activity.
icons.example: A dot or number near the bell may mean that an alert is waiting for you.
icons.caution: An alert is not always urgent. Read it before taking action.
icons.audio_text: The Notifications icon shows alerts, reminders, and recent activity. An alert is not always urgent.

icons.name: Wi-Fi
icons.meaning: Shows or manages a wireless internet connection.
icons.example: More filled curves usually indicate a stronger Wi-Fi connection.
icons.caution: Public Wi-Fi may not be private. Avoid sensitive activity unless the connection is trusted.
icons.audio_text: The Wi-Fi icon shows or manages a wireless internet connection. Public Wi-Fi may not be private.

icons.name: Lock
icons.meaning: Indicates security, privacy, or protected access.
icons.example: A lock near a website address means the connection between your browser and the website is encrypted.
icons.caution: A lock does not prove that the website itself is honest or safe.
icons.audio_text: The Lock icon indicates security, privacy, or protected access. It does not prove that a website is trustworthy.

icons.name: View
icons.meaning: Shows hidden content or opens a preview.
icons.example: Near a password field, the eye may temporarily reveal the characters you typed.
icons.caution: Hide a revealed password before someone else can see the screen.
icons.audio_text: The View icon shows hidden content or opens a preview. Hide a revealed password when others can see your screen.

icons.name: Camera
icons.meaning: Opens the camera or lets you add a photograph or video.
icons.example: Use Camera for a video call, profile photo, document scan, or picture message.
icons.caution: An app may ask for camera permission. Allow it only when the feature needs the camera.
icons.audio_text: The Camera icon opens the camera or lets you add a photograph or video. Review camera permission requests.

icons.name: Microphone
icons.meaning: Starts voice input, recording, or speech-to-text.
icons.example: Use Microphone to dictate a message, speak a search, record audio, or join a call.
icons.caution: An app may ask for microphone permission. Allow it only when the feature needs to listen.
icons.audio_text: The Microphone icon starts voice input, recording, or speech-to-text. Review microphone permission requests.

icons.name: Volume
icons.meaning: Controls or indicates sound level.
icons.example: Use Volume to make videos, calls, alerts, or spoken directions louder or quieter.
icons.caution: A slash through the speaker usually means the sound is muted.
icons.audio_text: The Volume icon controls or indicates sound level. A slash through the speaker usually means muted.

icons.name: Close
icons.meaning: Closes a window, message, menu, or screen.
icons.example: Use Close when you are finished with a pop-up or want to dismiss a screen.
icons.caution: Closing a document may prompt you to save changes first.
icons.audio_text: The Close icon closes a window, message, menu, or screen. Save important changes before closing a document.

icons.name: Forward
icons.meaning: Moves to the next page or returns to a page after using Back.
icons.example: Use Forward in a browser after going back to the previous page.
icons.caution: In messages, a similar arrow may send content to another person.
icons.audio_text: The Forward icon moves to the next page or returns to a page after using Back.

icons.name: Refresh
icons.meaning: Loads the current page or information again.
icons.example: Use Refresh when a webpage looks outdated or did not finish loading.
icons.caution: Refreshing a form may clear information you have entered.
icons.audio_text: The Refresh icon loads the current page or information again. A form may clear when refreshed.

icons.name: Save
icons.meaning: Stores your current work so you can use it later.
icons.example: Use Save after editing a document, spreadsheet, or picture.
icons.caution: Check the folder and filename so you can find the saved item later.
icons.audio_text: The Save icon stores your current work. Check the folder and filename so you can find it later.

icons.name: Print
icons.meaning: Sends a document or picture to a printer.
icons.example: Use Print when you need a paper copy of a document or confirmation.
icons.caution: Review the printer, page count, and number of copies before confirming.
icons.audio_text: The Print icon sends a document or picture to a printer. Review the page count and number of copies.

icons.name: Folder
icons.meaning: Contains files or other folders.
icons.example: Open a Folder to find saved documents, photographs, or downloads.
icons.caution: Moving or deleting a folder may affect everything stored inside it.
icons.audio_text: The Folder icon contains files or other folders. Moving or deleting it may affect everything inside.

icons.name: Document
icons.meaning: Represents a file containing text or other information.
icons.example: Select Document to open, edit, share, or review a file.
icons.caution: Open unexpected documents carefully, especially when received from an unknown sender.
icons.audio_text: The Document icon represents a file containing text or other information. Be careful with unexpected files.

icons.name: Play
icons.meaning: Starts a video, recording, song, or animation.
icons.example: Use Play to begin watching or listening.
icons.caution: Check your volume before starting media in a shared space.
icons.audio_text: The Play icon starts a video, recording, song, or animation. Check the volume first.

icons.name: Pause
icons.meaning: Temporarily stops media while keeping your place.
icons.example: Use Pause when you want to stop briefly and continue later.
icons.caution: Pause does not always stop a live call or microphone.
icons.audio_text: The Pause icon temporarily stops media while keeping your place.

icons.name: Stop
icons.meaning: Ends playback, recording, or another active process.
icons.example: Use Stop to finish an audio recording or end media playback.
icons.caution: Stopping a recording may finish the file and require you to start a new one.
icons.audio_text: The Stop icon ends playback, recording, or another active process.

icons.name: Phone
icons.meaning: Starts or represents a telephone or internet call.
icons.example: Use Phone to call a contact or join an audio meeting.
icons.caution: Confirm the contact before calling or returning an unfamiliar number.
icons.audio_text: The Phone icon starts or represents a call. Confirm the contact before calling an unfamiliar number.

icons.name: Message
icons.meaning: Opens text messages, chat, or a conversation.
icons.example: Use Message to read or send a text or chat response.
icons.caution: Do not send passwords, verification codes, or sensitive information to unverified contacts.
icons.audio_text: The Message icon opens text messages or chat. Do not send passwords or verification codes to unverified contacts.

icons.name: Send
icons.meaning: Delivers a message, email, form, or file.
icons.example: Use Send after reviewing a message and its recipients.
icons.caution: Sending may be difficult to undo. Review the recipient and attachments first.
icons.audio_text: The Send icon delivers a message, email, form, or file. Review recipients and attachments first.

icons.name: Contacts
icons.meaning: Opens saved names, phone numbers, and contact details.
icons.example: Use Contacts to find a person before calling or messaging them.
icons.caution: Apps may request access to your contacts. Allow it only when needed.
icons.audio_text: The Contacts icon opens saved names and contact details. Review requests for contact access.

icons.name: Calendar
icons.meaning: Shows dates, appointments, reminders, and scheduled events.
icons.example: Use Calendar to check an appointment or create an event.
icons.caution: Review the date, time, time zone, and guests before saving an event.
icons.audio_text: The Calendar icon shows dates and scheduled events. Review the date, time, time zone, and guests.

icons.name: Help
icons.meaning: Opens instructions, support information, or answers to common questions.
icons.example: Use Help when you need guidance about an app or website.
icons.caution: Use support links inside the official app or website rather than unexpected pop-ups.
icons.audio_text: The Help icon opens instructions or support information. Prefer support links inside the official app or website.

icons.name: Information
icons.meaning: Shows additional details about an item, setting, or situation.
icons.example: Use Information to learn why a notice appeared or view details about a file.
icons.caution: Information explains something but does not always mean it is approved or safe.
icons.audio_text: The Information icon shows additional details about an item, setting, or situation.

icons.name: Warning
icons.meaning: Signals that something needs attention before you continue.
icons.example: Pause at a Warning icon and read the complete message before choosing an action.
icons.caution: Do not let urgent wording pressure you. Close suspicious messages and verify through a trusted source.
icons.audio_text: The Warning icon signals that something needs attention. Pause, read the message, and verify suspicious requests.

icons.name: Location
icons.meaning: Shows a place or indicates that an app may use your location.
icons.example: Use Location for maps, directions, weather, or nearby services.
icons.caution: Allow location access only when needed and choose approximate location when sufficient.
icons.audio_text: The Location icon shows a place or location access. Allow location only when needed.

icons.name: Bluetooth
icons.meaning: Connects nearby wireless devices such as headphones, keyboards, or cars.
icons.example: Use Bluetooth settings to pair a trusted nearby device.
icons.caution: Confirm the device name before pairing and reject unexpected pairing requests.
icons.audio_text: The Bluetooth icon connects nearby wireless devices. Confirm the device name before pairing.
